refine_with_pixal3d.title: Refine With Pixal3D
refine_with_pixal3d.description: Also run the Pixal3D stage after trellis.cpp and publish its result as the next revision of the same scene. Much slower; Pixal3D runs at its own measured resolution. Check the 3d.image_to_3d capability before requesting it.

title: SceneFromImageRequest
description: Generate an experimental 3D scene from an existing PNG, JPEG or WebP image Asset using a locally adopted runtime. Returns a detached Job; use media.job.status or media.job.cancel. Preserves the input image, publishes a validated Blender revision and GLB with lineage. Runs trellis.cpp by default; set refine_with_pixal3d to continue into Pixal3D. Check 3d.image_to_3d capability before calling. Structural validation does not guarantee visual quality.
